title: 第4章  婊子就该踩在地上
content_zh:
“楚弛，你干什么！”
“你就非得作死吗？你作死就算了，还让我楚家跟着你一起丢脸？”
楚枫等人，先后质问。
楚弛看了一眼四周的人，他的眼神，桀骜不驯。
楚弛知道，一个人想要被别人认可，只有成为强者。
他根本没有废话，而是走到了远处空地，朝庞妃烟勾了勾手指头。
“婊子，来吧！”
庞妃烟眼神一冷，心道：“楚弛，既然你执意找死，我就成全你。”
她双脚一踏，身体像是轻鸿，去到了楚弛身边。
她眼里的杀意，楚弛看得一清二楚。
“妃烟，你上去吓唬吓唬他就行了，千万不要伤他性命。”
这时，庞庆洋的声音传来了。
这一战，她不认为庞妃烟会败，但他也不想庞妃烟因为冲动而杀了楚弛。
那岂不是变相验证了楚弛说的话是真的吗？
庞妃烟眼神一颤，似乎清醒了一点。
是啊，虽然是生死战，却也不能杀楚弛。
“楚弛，你应该是做了一场噩梦，将我当成了仇人。但，你真傻，我虽然迎战了，却又怎么舍得伤害你呢？我就站在这里，让你出气。
你尽管打我吧，我让你好好发泄发泄。来呀，打我……”
庞妃烟说得情真意切，最后居然闭上了眼睛。
那模样，绝对是任君宰割之姿。

你别说，她惺惺作态的样子，还真有感染力。
原本楚家人，就不怎么相信楚弛的话，这一刻，他们更是不信了。
有楚家人感叹道：“庞妃烟，真是一个好女人啊！宁愿自己挨打，让楚弛发泄，也不还手！”
“哎，楚弛不知道哪里来的好运！当时抓阄，他们怎么就抓到一起了呢。庞家第一美人，许配给了一个庸才……”
十五年前，庞家和楚家决定联姻，当时采取的是抓阄的方式，抓之前两方就商量好了，抓阄的结果，谁都不能改变。
“楚弛，动手吧。打我……”
庞妃烟的声音再次传来。
那睫毛颤抖的样子，我见犹怜。
她的声音刚刚落下，楚弛沙包大的拳头，已经落在了她的鼻子上！
只听咔擦一声响。
鼻梁断裂的声音，是那般清脆！
庞妃烟的身体，被巨大的力量，直接击飞了。
身体还在空中，鼻血飞流直下，在空中带起一抹殷红。
只是一击，全场所有人，瞪大了双眼，全部倒吸一口凉气。
谁都没想到，楚弛真的动手了！
一个闭着眼睛，我见犹怜的美人，他居然真的下得去手。
这小子，绝对得了失心疯了吧！
下得去手就算了，这力量，怎么这么大？
这绝对不是普通人的力量啊。
楚弛没有理会四周的惊愕，他瘪了瘪嘴，耸了耸肩，开口道。

“你们也听见了，是她让我打的，这种要求，我还是第一次听见。”
话落，楚弛的嘴角，咧开了一抹嗜血的笑容。
既然动手了，那他就没打算停止！
他双脚一踏，身体像是一枚炮弹，射向了还在倒飞的庞妃烟。
“什么，怎么这么快！”
“不对，这是修者才能拥有的力量和速度。楚弛什么时候，是修者了？不可能！”
四周所有人，眼珠子都快掉下来了。
惊愕间，楚弛已经去到了庞妃烟身旁。
此刻的庞妃烟，已经睁开了眼，她的眼神同样惊愕，她怎么也没想到，楚弛的力量这么大！
但现在不是惊讶的时候，因为楚弛的拳头，又落下了。
拳如雨落，应接不暇。
哪怕她已经反抗了，但失去先机，她根本挡不住。
只是十招之后，楚弛的拳头，击中了她的眼睛。
就算她用灵气护住了眼，她的眼眶，也立马肿了起来。
当她的身体，落在地上后。
两只眼睛，都肿得像是熊猫。
她的脸，青一块紫一块，没有一处地方，还保持完整。
此时，庞妃烟想要起身，楚弛四十四码的鞋子，已经踩在了她的脸上。楚弛的脚，像是有万钧之力，她居然无法挣脱。
那原本美丽的脸蛋，早就变换了形状。
她的嘴角，不仅有哈喇子，还有鲜血。

但这怎么可能啊。
楚弛不是一个普通人吗？
而她，可是凡人境三层的修者啊！
凡人，怎么可能是修者的对手。
她自然不知道，楚弛现在的修为，也是凡人境三层。
而且，他是荒古大日体，荒古大日体一旦突破桎梏，成为修者，绝对是同层无敌。
“不可能，不可能。”
庞妃烟嘴里重复着这句话。
楚弛眼神清冷，居高临下地道：“没有什么不可能。婊子，下辈子，别再惹我。”
楚弛捡起旁边一块大石头，他举着大石，砸向了庞妃烟的脑袋。
他似乎要硬生生将庞妃烟砸死！
这一幕，终于让四周的人反应了过来。
“住手！”
楚山和庞庆洋第一时间发出冷喝。
凡人境九层的气息，瞬间释放。
这威压，凡人境六层以下，绝对无法忍受，会身体发软跪在地上。
但楚弛，却浑然未觉。
他动用了识海里镇天鼎的力量，这点威压，算得了什么？
楚弛手里的石头，还是砸了下去！
“不！”

庞妃烟双目惊恐，裤裆湿了一片，居然直接吓尿了。
“尿了？哈哈哈哈。”
楚弛忽然停下了。
手里的大石头，距离庞妃烟只有零点零一公分。
他俯下身体，朝庞妃烟轻语了几句。
刚刚说完，楚山和庞庆洋出现在他身旁。
楚山，拉着他，后退了几步。
庞庆洋则抱起了庞妃烟，转身就走！因为他根本无脸逗留。
这生死战，是庞妃烟主动答应的。就算庞妃烟被打，被侮辱了，他也什么都不能说。
离开楚家后，庞庆洋才开口问道：“妃烟，他刚才对你说了什么。”
庞妃烟咬住嘴唇，根本没有回答。
刚才楚弛说的话，她绝对不可能告诉别人。
楚弛说：“杀了你，是便宜了你，你不是浪荡？在我面前勾搭野男人吗？
我今后，会将你送入怡春院，让附近的人，都去策马奔腾，我要让你当头牌，被千人驾，万人骑，等着吧，这一天，不会远。”
楚弛，也要杀人诛心！
就好像那一晚，他绝望无助，被逼得跳崖一样。
他也要让庞妃烟，体会那种感觉。
只是杀了她，太便宜她了。
content_en:
"Chu Chi, what are you doing!"
"Do you have to seek death? You just want to seek death, and you want me, the Chu family, to be embarrassed along with you?"
Chu Feng and others questioned him one after another.
Chu Chi glanced at the people around him, his eyes were unruly.
Chu Chi knew that if a person wants to be recognized by others, he can only become strong.
He didn't talk nonsense at all, but walked to the open space in the distance and curled his fingers at Pang Feiyan.
"Bitch, come on!"
Pang Feiyan's eyes turned cold and she said in her heart: "Chu Chi, since you insist on seeking death, I will help you."
She stepped on her feet and moved to Chu Chi's side like a light dragon.
Chu Chi could clearly see the killing intent in her eyes.
"Fei Yan, just go up and scare him. Don't hurt his life."
At this time, Pang Qingyang's voice came.
In this battle, she didn't think Pang Feiyan would lose, but he also didn't want Pang Feiyan to kill Chu Chi out of impulse.
Doesn't that verify in disguise that what Chu Chi said is true?
Pang Feiyan's eyes trembled and she seemed to wake up a little.
Yes, even though it was a life and death battle, Chu Chi couldn't be killed.
"Chu Chi, you must have had a nightmare and regarded me as your enemy. But you are so stupid. Although I fought, how could I be willing to hurt you? I will stand here and let you vent your anger.
Just hit me and I'll let you vent. Come on, hit me..."
Pang Feiyan spoke so sincerely that she actually closed her eyes in the end.
That look is definitely at the mercy of the king.
Don't tell me, her coy look is really contagious.
Originally, the Chu family didn't believe Chu Chi's words, but at this moment, they didn't believe it even more.
Some members of the Chu family sighed: "Pang Feiyan, what a good woman! She would rather be beaten and let Chu Chi vent than fight back!"
"Hey, I don't know where Chu Chi's good luck came from! How could they be caught together when we were drawing lots? The most beautiful woman in the Pang family was betrothed to a mediocre person..."
Fifteen years ago, the Pang family and the Chu family decided to marry. At that time, they adopted the method of drawing lots. The two parties had discussed it before the marriage, and no one could change the result of the lot.
"Chu Chi, do it. Hit me..."
Pang Feiyan's voice came again.
I felt pity for the trembling eyelashes.
As soon as her voice fell, Chu Chi's sandbag-sized fist had already landed on her nose!
Just hear a clicking sound.
The sound of a broken nose is so crisp!
Pang Feiyan's body was directly knocked away by the huge force.
The body is still in the air, nosebleeds are flying down, bringing a bright red in the air.
With just one blow, everyone in the audience widened their eyes and took a breath.
No one expected that Chu Chi would actually take action!
He could actually do something to this beautiful woman who I felt pity for with her eyes closed.
This kid is definitely going crazy when he wins or loses!
Even if you can do it, why is this power so powerful?
This is definitely not the power of ordinary people.
Chu Chi ignored the astonishment around him. He pursed his lips, shrugged, and said.
"You also heard that she asked me to hit her. This is the first time I heard such a request."
As soon as he finished speaking, a bloodthirsty smile appeared on Chu Chi's lips.
Now that he has started, he has no intention of stopping!
He stepped on his feet, and his body was like a cannonball, shooting at Pang Feiyan, who was still flying upside down.
"What, why so fast!"
"No, this is the power and speed that only cultivators can possess. When did Chu Chi become a cultivator? Impossible!"
The eyes of everyone around him almost dropped.
In shock, Chu Chi had already reached Pang Feiyan's side.
At this moment, Pang Feiyan had opened her eyes, and her eyes were equally astonished. She never expected that Chu Chi was so powerful!
But now is not the time to be surprised, because Chu Chi's fist fell again.
The fists are falling like rain, and there is no way to catch them.
EvenShe had resisted, but she lost the opportunity and couldn't stop it.
Just ten moves later, Chu Chi's fist hit her eye.
Even if she used spiritual energy to protect her eyes, her eye sockets immediately became swollen.
When her body fell to the ground.
Both eyes were swollen like pandas.
Her face was covered in bruises and bruises, with no place intact.
At this time, Pang Feiyan wanted to get up, but Chu Chi's size 44 shoes had already stepped on her face. Chu Chi's feet seemed to have great strength, but she couldn't break free.
The originally beautiful face had long since changed its shape.
At the corner of her mouth, there was not only irritation, but also blood.
But how is this possible?
Isn't Chu Chi an ordinary person?
And she is a cultivator at the third level of the mortal realm!
How could a mortal be the opponent of a cultivator?
Naturally, she didn't know that Chu Chi's current cultivation level was also at the third level of the mortal realm.
Moreover, he is the Ancient Great Sun Body. Once the Ancient Great Sun Body breaks through the shackles and becomes a cultivator, he will definitely be invincible at the same level.
"No way, no way."
Pang Fei repeated these words in her cigarette holder.
Chu Chi's eyes were cold and he said condescendingly: "Nothing is impossible. Bitch, don't mess with me again in the next life."
Chu Chi picked up a big stone next to him. He raised the big stone and hit Pang Feiyan on the head.
It seemed like he was going to smash Pang Feiyan to death!
This scene finally made the people around react.
"Stop!"
Chu Shan and Pang Qingyang immediately shouted coldly.
The breath of the ninth level of the mortal realm was released instantly.
This pressure is absolutely unbearable for a person below the sixth level of the mortal realm, and his body will become weak and he will kneel on the ground.
But Chu Chi was completely unaware of it.
He used the power of the Heaven-Suppressing Cauldron in the Sea of ​​​​Consciousness. What does this pressure mean?
Chu Chi still smashed the stone in his hand!
"No!"
Pang Feiyan's eyes were horrified, her crotch was wet, and she actually peed out of fear.
"Peeed? Hahahaha."
Chu Chi suddenly stopped.
The big stone in his hand was only 0.01 centimeters away from Pang Feiyan.
He leaned down and whispered a few words to Pang Feiyan.
Just after he finished speaking, Chu Shan and Pang Qingyang appeared beside him.
Chu Shan pulled him and took a few steps back.
Pang Qingyang picked up Pang Feiyan, turned around and left! Because he has no face to linger.
Pang Feiyan took the initiative to agree to this life and death battle. Even if Pang Feiyan was beaten and insulted, he couldn't say anything.
After leaving the Chu family, Pang Qingyang asked: "Fei Yan, what did he just say to you."
Pang Feiyan bit her lip and didn't answer at all.
There was absolutely no way she could tell anyone what Chu Chi said just now.
Chu Chi said: "Killing you will give you an advantage. Aren't you a prostitute? Are you hooking up with a wild man in front of me?
From now on, I will send you to Yichun Courtyard and let everyone nearby ride their horses. I will let you be the leader, driven by thousands of people and ridden by ten thousand people. Just wait, this day will not be far away. "
Chu Chi also wants to kill people and punish his heart!
Just like that night, he was so desperate and helpless that he was forced to jump off the cliff.
He also wanted Pang Feiyan to experience that feeling.
Just killing her would be too cheap for her.
